title: Maximum velocity correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the maximum speed v_m must be 16 m/s.

title: Horizontal time correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the time on the horizontal slide t_2 must be 6.4 s.

title: Friction coefficient correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the coefficient of kinetic friction μ must be 0.25.

title: Average velocity reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The student applies the average velocity formula (v_avg = (v_initial + v_final)/2) correctly to both the inclined and horizontal segments.

title: System of equations setup
description: Important Criteria: The student sets up the correct simultaneous equations using l1 = (v_m/2)*(t - t_2) and l2 = (v_m/2)*t_2.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important Criteria: The student applies the work-energy theorem correctly, equating the net work to zero (or the change in kinetic energy to zero) over the entire path.

title: Friction work calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly calculates the total work done by friction as -μmg(l1 cos θ + l2).

title: Gravity work calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student explicitly identifies the work done by gravity on the incline as mgl1 sin θ.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign error in the work-energy equation, e.g., adding instead of subtracting the friction work.

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses an incorrect normal force on the incline (e.g., mg instead of mg cos θ) when calculating friction work.
